property_summary: For any caller and deposited amount, calling withdrawAll on the correct contract never reverts (it only does the external call when the caller's credit > 0); the mutant flips the guard so it will attempt the external call when credit == 0 and thus can revert for callers where the callee always reverts, violating the no-revert property for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the conditional guard `if (oCredit > 0)` with `if (oCredit == 0)` so behavior flips: previously no-op for zero credit, now attempts withdraw and likely reverts (or vice versa).
